v1_regression_coverage: SQLite incident/dry-run/approval persistence across process restart
completed remediation idempotent replay without a second workflow update or retry
workflow-update crash recovery using approved writable-definition fingerprint evidence
retry crash recovery using n8n retryOf execution metadata
fail-closed ambiguous retry recovery with no blind duplicate retry
raw input/workflow snapshots excluded from durable incident storage
operator-token protection when side-effect gates are enabled
metadata-only retry lookup scoped to the workflow
limitations: SQLite and the built-in lease are a single-service-instance baseline, not a distributed multi-replica lock.
Retry verification performs a bounded immediate read; nonterminal executions are returned as pending.
Ambiguous retry crash recovery intentionally requires manual reconciliation rather than risking a duplicate retry.
The evaluation sets are deterministic fixtures and mocks; no live production n8n workflow was mutated by the committed benchmark.
The built-in operator token is a shared-secret baseline; stronger production deployments should use an authenticated gateway or workload identity.
